title: Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) vs. Inter-Token Latency (ITL / TPOT): · Chunked Prefill · Disaggregated Prefill-Decode Servin…
prompt: **Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) vs. Inter-Token Latency (ITL / TPOT):** In an LLM serving benchmark, a system has great ITL (8ms/token) but terrible TTFT (4.5 seconds). What is causing the bottleneck (long prompts queuing behind decode steps), and how does **Chunked Prefill** or **Disaggregated Prefill-Decode Serving** (running Prefill on compute-optimized nodes and transferring the KV cache over RDMA to memory-bandwidth-optimized Decode nodes) solve it?

resources.title: Chunked Prefill: Overlapping Compute and Communication
resources.why: Explains splitting a long prompt into chunks and mixing them with decode steps, plus the chunk-size trade-off.

resources.title: Throughput is Not All You Need: DistServe
resources.why: Shows prefill/decode interference, the problem chunked prefill and disaggregation both address.
